task: Disentangled Dynamic Intrusion Detection with Multi-scale Feature Learning (DIDS-MFL)

statistical_disentanglement.description: Disentangle entangled feature distributions via mutual information-based feature differentiation
statistical_disentanglement.method: Non-parameterized optimization based on mutual information minimization between feature groups

memory_representation.description: Memory model to generate compact representations from disentangled features
memory_representation.method: Key-value memory network with attention-based addressing

representational_disentanglement.description: Further disentangle representations to highlight attack-specific features
representational_disentanglement.method: Contrastive learning with infoNCE loss for representation separation

dynamic_graph_diffusion.description: Graph diffusion for spatiotemporal aggregation in evolving data streams
dynamic_graph_diffusion.method: Dynamic graph construction with diffusion-based message passing

multi_scale_feature_fusion.description: Fuse features at multiple scales for enhanced few-shot learning
multi_scale_feature_fusion.method: Concatenation of features from statistical, representational, and graph-diffusion scales

few_shot_classifier.description: Classification with prototype-based few-shot learning capability
few_shot_classifier.method: Prototypical network with cosine similarity matching
